description: Exchanges an OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect authorization code for tokens at the identity provider's token endpoint. Works with any provider (POSTs a standard application/x-www-form-urlencoded authorization_code grant) — Microsoft Entra, Google, Auth0, etc.
label: Exchange Code for Tokens

options.name: token-endpoint
options.label: Token Endpoint
options.info: The identity provider's token endpoint, e.g. https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant-id}/oauth2/v2.0/token

options.name: client-id
options.label: Client ID
options.info: The identity provider's client ID for this application

options.name: client-secret
options.label: Client Secret
options.info: The identity provider's client secret for this application

options.name: code
options.label: Authorization Code
options.info: The "code" query parameter received on the redirect URI callback

options.name: redirect-uri
options.label: Redirect URI
options.info: Must exactly match the redirect URI used on the authorization request

options.name: access-token
options.label: Access Token
options.info: Use this to make further calls to the provider's API (e.g. Microsoft Graph) on the user's behalf, if needed

options.name: id-token
options.label: ID Token
options.info: Pass this into an ID-token-verification step to check its claims
